messages:
Priya (Design): quick sync — new compact 'recipient chips' for alert preview. mock: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/recipient-chips-v3.png
Marco (PM): looks cleaner. main concern: oncall needs to see exact endpoints during rotations. chips must expand easily.
Devon (Frontend): plan: show up to 2 chips, then a focusable '+N more recipients' button that expands inline. expansion lazy-loads recipients and shows spinner. keyboard: button has aria-expanded and toggles focus into list.
Ellie (Accessibility): a11y notes: expanded list must be announced via aria-live; prepend '(Suppressed)' to the region if suppression applies; color alone can't indicate suppressed state. make tooltip focusable.
Sam (SRE): backend will return resolvedRecipients + mappingRule names and suppression annotation. include suppressed-by reason string so UI can render 'suppressed by: <rule>' inline.
Priya (Design): microcopy: header -> 'Alert when threshold is reached'. suppression pill -> 'Suppressed — maintenance until Jun 11, 09:00 UTC'. +N copy: '+3 more recipients' (explicit).
Devon (Frontend): quick example for dev story:
```
resolvedRecipients: [
  "slack:#alerts (mapped by: primary-route)",
  "pagerduty:infra-oncall (mapped by: p90-escalation)",
]
suppression: "scheduled maintenance until 2024-06-11T09:00Z"
```
Priya (Design): decision list: 1) chips with up to 2 shown + focusable '+N more recipients' 2) inline expansion announced and keyboardable 3) suppression inline with reason + end time 4) lazy-load expansion with spinner 5) copy change to 'Alert when threshold is reached'. I'll update figma and drop link.
Ellie (Accessibility): i'll add a checklist to the ticket (focus behavior, aria-live, aria-expanded, readable suppression label).
Sam (SRE): INF-4781 created for resolvedRecipients API. ui-bot: design mock published at https://figma.redwood.app/file/recipient-chips/v3
Priya (Design): thanks — will post figma + ticket links and close thread once they're in the ticket. :sparkles:
